title: The Community Garden Plan: Changing Course After New Evidence · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Last month, the Green Street Community Group met to plan a new garden. They wanted to grow vegetables for local families. At first, they planned to use the small park behind the library. They thought the soil was good. They also believed the park was sunny all day. However, a soil test showed a problem. The test found heavy metals in the soil. The group leader, Maria, said, “We cannot grow food here. It is not safe.” The members were surprised. They asked, “Are there other places?” Maria replied, “Yes, but we need to check them.” Next, the group looked at two other sites. Site A was a empty lot near the school. Site B was a rooftop garden on the community center. The group tested both places. Site A had clean soil, but it was very small. Site B had strong sunlight and clean containers, but it was on the third floor.
prompt:
Part 1
Do you like gardens?
Is there a park near your home?
What vegetables do you like?
Do you often go outside?

Part 2
Describe a time when you changed a plan because of new information. You should say: what the plan was; what new information you got; how you changed the plan; and how you felt about the change.

Part 3
Why do plans sometimes change?
Is it good to change plans?
How do people get new information?
What can groups do when they have a problem?
